Зверобой.about: Hyperforin blocks serotonin reuptake: works for mild depression, comparable to SSRIs.
Зверобой.caution: For mild-moderate depression: comparable effectiveness to SSRI, BUT fewer side effects. DOES NOT work for severe depression/suicidality. CRITICAL: interaction with drugs (CYP3A4 inducer) - reduces the effectiveness of oral contraceptives, anticoagulants, antiretrovirals, immunosuppressants. Photosensitivity.
Зверобой.food_sources: In pharmacies there is herb for tea, but the working doses are a standardized extract; you cannot get them with tea.
Зверобой.guidelines: 2023 MA (vs SSRI): parity in response and remission; 2021 SR: CYP3A4 inducer, interaction with warfarin. Mild to moderate depression only.
Зверобой.how_to_choose: Extract 300 mg 3 times a day (0.3% hypericin), course 4-6 weeks; check for drug interactions.
mechs: Mild depression; induction of CYP3A4 - interactions!
Comparability with SSRIs: response and remission
Response/remission comparable to SSRIs (RR ~1.0), dropout lower (OR 0.59); 27 RCT, 3808
Safety limitations: severe depression and duration
Data is only 4-12 weeks; There is no evidence for severe depression and suicidality
Зверобой.myths: “Treats severe depression” - mild/moderate only. "Safe Herb" - CYP3A4 inducer: reduces contraceptives and anticoagulants.
Зверобой.name: St. John's Wort
Зверобой.onset: Effect by 4-12 weeks, noticeable from 2-4 weeks; data is only short-term.
Зверобой.title: St. John's Wort
Зверобой.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Зверобой.who_needs: Mild to moderate depression, when you want to avoid the side effects of SSRIs; Contraindicated in severe depression and suicidality.
